title: What if you could rob a bank and never get caught
description: A fictional animated thought experiment with three adults: Maya guides the class, Leo imagines taking a bank money bag, and Officer Max pursues him but can never close the gap. Everyone can see Leo; only getting caught is impossible, with no extra powers. Tell one continuous, concrete story: open in a classroom, walk across an outdoor field, imagine the bank lobby, sustain a visible street chase, pause at a cafe where the speaking character actually lifts and drinks a cup, then have Leo voluntarily hand the money bag to Maya and return to the classroom. End with a specific consequence and a small visual joke, not a moral lecture or abstract slogans. Use all three voices and moving shots in at least half the beats. Keep the bank event high-level and fictional, with no weapons, violence, practical robbery/security details, or evasion tactics.
